start: Signed in as the owner; internet on; member page; the member's gym plan is running

steps.action: On the plan that ends last tap "Freeze / extra days"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Freeze / extra days"
"<plan> last day: <day>."
Reason chips "Freeze – Medical", "Freeze – Travel", "Freeze – Other", "Gift – Extra days"
Day chips and the box "Or type the days (1–365)", starting at 7
"New last day: <day>" with "Valid till then (<when>)."
must_not: The button on an earlier plan when a renewal is already waiting

steps.action: Pick a reason and a number of days, tap "Add <n> days"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
Toast "Plan moved <n> days later."
must_not: The days added twice
The price or dues changed

user_sees: The new last day
A note line with the days and the reason
must_not: A later plan of the member now overlapping
The note in a different date style from the page

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; a plan that has not started yet

steps.action: Tap "Change start date" on that plan
user_sees: Sheet titled "Change start date"
"<plan>: now <first day> → <last day>."
Box "New start date" with "Pick the day the member will start."
"Save start date" greyed while the day is unchanged
must_not: The button on a plan that already started or is cancelled

user_sees: "The member keeps every day they paid for. The plan will end on <day>."
must_not: A shorter plan than was paid for

user_sees: Toast "Start date changed to <day>."
The row shows the new first and last day
must_not: The plan now overlapping another plan of the member
A start day in the past saved

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; a PT pack ended with sessions left

steps.action: In the PT card tap "Extend" on the ended pack
user_sees: The same sheet: "<plan> ended on <day>. <n> PT sessions left."
must_not: The gym plan opened in place of the PT pack

steps.action: Add fewer days than have passed
user_sees: "Still ended (<when>). Add more days to reach today."
must_not: "Valid till then" for a day already gone

user_sees: Toast "Plan moved <n> days later."
The pack is back under running packs with "Mark session"
must_not: The unused sessions lost

start: Signed in as the owner; "Freeze / extra days" sheet open

steps.action: Type 0, then 400, then letters in the days box
user_sees: Under the box: "A whole number from 1 to 365."
Button reads "Add days", greyed
"New last day: —"
must_not: A save with a wrong number
A minus number moving the last day back

steps.action: Open "Change start date" and pick a day that runs into another plan
user_sees: A red line under the date; "Save start date" greyed
must_not: Two plans covering the same days

steps.action: Sign in as front desk staff and open the same page
user_sees: No "Freeze / extra days" and no "Change start date" on any plan
must_not: Front desk moving a plan's days

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; 7 days were added a moment ago

steps.action: Add 15 more days with another reason
user_sees: Toast "Plan moved 15 days later."
Two note lines, one for each change
must_not: The first note overwritten
The last day moved by 15 from the old day, not the new one

steps.action: Look for a way to take the days back
user_sees: No undo is offered on this page
must_not: A silent change of the last day with no note

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; days added with the reason "Freeze – Medical"

steps.action: Look where the reason shows, in the panel and in the member's app
user_sees: The reason in the note under the plan on the gym's own member page
must_not: The word "Medical" or the typed "What happened" text shown outside the gym's own logins
The note in an export or a message to the member
